plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: Phase-based AI development plugin with 20 specialised engineering agents (frontend, backend, DBA, QA, DevOps, accessibility, performance, security, plus pm-architect, gap-finder, and gang-bridge). Drives features through 6 phases — strategy, design, API architecture, implementation, quality, launch — with file-based handoffs. Adds /crew drive, /crew deploy, /crew gaps, /crew features over upstream archflow. Integrates with the Gang plugin via /crew gang-import and /crew gang-escalate so strategic GO Packages flow into engineering execution without manual copy/paste.
